info.title: go-ios REST API
info.description:
go-ios REST API.

This is the *ideal* contract for the go-ios REST server. It is authored
spec-first in TypeSpec and emitted to OpenAPI 3.1; the go-ios server conforms
to this document (there is no backward-compatibility constraint yet).

## Authentication

Every route under `/api/v1` requires a bearer token:
`Authorization: Bearer <GO_IOS_API_KEY>`. The server refuses to start unless
either an API key is configured or it is launched with `--disable-auth`.

When the server is started with `--disable-auth`, authentication is **not**
enforced and the `Authorization` header may be omitted. The Swagger UI
(`/swagger/*`) is always unauthenticated and lives outside `/api/v1`, so it is
not modeled here.

## Device routing

Device-scoped routes live under `/device/{udid}`. A middleware resolves the
udid: an unknown udid yields `404`, an empty udid yields `422`. The
`/device/{udid}/apps` subgroup is serialized per-udid (one concurrent request
per device).

## Streaming

Long-lived endpoints (`/notifications`, `/ostrace`, `/syslog`, `/listen`,
`/sysmontap` and the async `/jobs/{id}/logs`) are modeled as real Server-Sent
Events (`text/event-stream`) with typed event payloads. See streaming.tsp.

AXAuditIssue.description:
One accessibility audit issue (`accessibility.AXAuditIssue`) from
`POST /device/{udid}/ax/audit`. Open map — shape depends on the audit type.

AXElement.description:
`GET /device/{udid}/ax` — a snapshot of the currently focused accessibility
element. Open map (backend-defined element attributes).

AXEnabledRequest.description:
Body for the accessibility toggle PUTs (`/voiceover`, `/zoom`). The desired
state may also be supplied as an `enabled` query param; a parseable body wins.

AppInfo.description:
Installed application metadata. This is an open map: keys come straight from
the app's Info.plist. Common keys are surfaced for discoverability but any
additional keys may be present.

bundleId.description: Bundle id of the app whose state changed.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the change was observed.

event.description:
Event kind.
`attached` when a device connects, `detached` when it disconnects,
`paired` when a pairing record appears.

udid.description: The device udid (serial number), when known.

AttachDetachEvent.description: A device was attached to or detached from the host.

BatteryInfo.description:
`GET /device/{udid}/battery` — battery diagnostics (`ios.BatteryInfo`).
Open map; commonly-present keys are surfaced for discoverability.

BatteryRegistry.description:
`GET /device/{udid}/battery/registry` — battery IORegistry stats
(`diagnostics.IORegistry`). Open map; common keys surfaced.

CloudConfig.description:
`GET /device/{udid}/cloudconfig` — the device cloud configuration
(`mcinstall` GetCloudConfiguration): supervision status, skip-setup options
and organization info. Open map.

CPU_TotalLoad.description: Total CPU load across all cores (0–100).

CpuUsageSample.description: A single sysmontap CPU-usage sample. Open map; sampler keys vary by OS.

action.description: `enable` to turn developer mode on, `reveal` to expose the settings menu.

enablePostRestart.description: When enabling, also arm developer mode to persist across the next reboot.

formatedDate.description: Human-readable RFC850 date on the device.

TimeIntervalSince1970.description: Device clock as Unix epoch seconds.

address.description: Network address for a device reached over the network / tunnel.

userspaceTUN.description: True if reachable via the userspace TUN tunnel.

DeviceEntry.description: A single device as returned by `GET /list`.

DeviceInfo.description:
`GET /device/{udid}/info` — lockdown values plus `instruments:*` keys.
Open dictionary; values are heterogeneous.

serialNumber.description: The device udid (serial number). This is what device-scoped routes key on.

DeviceProperties.description: Low-level device properties reported by usbmuxd / lockdown.

Model.description: AFC model identifier reported by the device.

DiskSpaceInfo.description:
`GET /device/{udid}/diskspace` — AFC filesystem info (`afc.DeviceInfo`).
Total/free/used bytes and block size. Open map; common keys surfaced.

EnabledRequest.description: Request body for the `enabled`-toggle settings endpoints.

FileDomain.description: Domain of the on-device file service.

FileEntry.description: A single entry in a device directory listing.

hostPort.description: Local (host) TCP port to listen on.

targetPort.description: Device TCP port to forward to.

files.description: File/directory names in the listed directory.

FsyncPushResult.description: `POST /device/{udid}/fsync/push` — result of an upload over AFC.

path.description: Full device-side path of this entry.

isDir.description: Whether the entry is a directory.

FsyncTreeEntry.description: One entry returned by the recursive `GET /device/{udid}/fsync/tree` walk.

entries.description: Flattened list of entries in the subtree.

FsyncTreeListing.description: `GET /device/{udid}/fsync/tree` — a recursive directory walk over AFC.

error.description: Human-readable error message. Present on failures.

GenericResponse.description:
The dominant response envelope used across the API. Success responses set
`message`; error responses set `error`. Streaming/middleware paths that emit
`gin.H{"error"|"message"}` are compatible with this shape.

Heartbeat.description: Periodic keep-alive frame emitted on every stream. Payload is empty.

InstalledProfiles.description:
`GET /device/{udid}/profiles` — installed configuration profiles.
Open dictionary; values are heterogeneous.

udid.description: The device udid the job runs on.

finishedAt.description: When the job reached a terminal state (absent while running).

result.description: Terminal result payload (e.g. test suites) when the job succeeded.

Job.description:
A long-running operation started via the REST API (test run, WDA runner,
port forward). Mirrors the server's `jobView`.

line.description: The raw log line (already newline-terminated in the buffer).

JobLogLine.description: A single line of a job's log output.

SupportedLocales.description: Supported locales advertised by the device.

SupportedLanguages.description: Supported UI languages advertised by the device.

process.description: Process name whose memory limit should be waived.

NetworkInfo.description:
`GET /device/{udid}/ip` — device network info discovered over pcapd
(`pcap.NetworkInfo`).

pid.description: Process id that emitted the entry.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the entry was emitted, if known.

present.description: Whether any text was present on the pasteboard.

text.description: The clipboard text (empty when `present` is false).

supervised.description: Whether the device was supervised (a supervision cert was supplied).

PrepareSkipOptions.description:
`GET /prepare/skip-options` — the static list of setup-pane skip options
usable when preparing a device. Host-scoped (device-free).

Profile.description: A single condition profile within a `ProfileType`.

ProfileType.description: A condition inducer profile type (e.g. thermal, network) with its variants.

bundleId.description: The app bundle identifier registered with App Store Connect.

p12Base64.description: The generated `.p12`, base64-encoded (absent when reusing a certificate).

ProvisioningResult.description:
`POST /sign/provision` — provisioning assets envelope. The mobileprovision
(and optionally the P12) are base64-encoded so one JSON response can carry
both binary artifacts. Host-scoped (device-free).

Port.description: TCP port the service is reachable on over the tunnel.

RsdServiceEntry.description: A single RSD (Remote Service Discovery) service entry.

RsdServices.description:
`GET /device/{udid}/rsd` — the device's Remote Service Discovery service list
keyed by service name. Requires a running tunnel (iOS 17+); devices without
RSD return `400`.

bundleId.description: Bundle id of the app under test.

testRunnerBundleId.description: Bundle id of the test runner. Defaults to `bundleId` if omitted.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the test runner.

args.description: Extra process arguments for the test runner.

xctest.description: Run as a plain XCTest (vs XCUITest).

StatusOk.description: Simple `{ "status": "ok" }` acknowledgement used by MDM clear operations.

privateKeyDerBase64.description: Private key in DER form, base64-encoded.

SupervisionCert.description:
`POST /prepare/create-cert` — a generated self-signed supervision identity,
returned as DER (base64) and PEM for both the certificate and private key.
Host-scoped (device-free).

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the line was emitted, if known.

SyslogMessage.description: A single syslog line from the device.

Udid.description: The device udid this tunnel serves.

UserspaceTUN.description: Whether this tunnel is a userspace TUN.

UserspaceTUNPort.description: Userspace TUN port, when `UserspaceTUN` is true.

Tunnel.description:
A running device tunnel as reported by the tunnel agent
(`GET /tunnels`, `POST /tunnels/{udid}/refresh`). Mirrors `tunnel.Tunnel`.

TunnelStopped.description: `DELETE /tunnels/{udid}` — acknowledgement that the tunnel was stopped.

method.description: HTTP method for a WDA passthrough (defaults to GET).

path.description: HTTP path for a WDA passthrough (required for the wda backend).

body.description: Raw HTTP request body for a WDA passthrough (base64 bytes on the wire).

rpcMethod.description: JSON-RPC method name for a DeviceKit passthrough.

rpcParams.description: JSON-RPC params for a DeviceKit passthrough.

UIAPIRequest.description:
`POST /device/{udid}/ui/api` request — raw passthrough to the backend
(`uidriver.APIRequest`). For WDA supply `method`/`path`/`body`; for DeviceKit
supply `rpcMethod`/`rpcParams`.

UIResponse.description:
A backend passthrough response. The body and content-type are forwarded from
WDA/DeviceKit verbatim, so the shape is backend-defined (open map).

bundleId.description: Bundle id of the WDA runner host app (e.g. `com.facebook.WebDriverAgentRunner.xctrunner`).

testBundleId.description: Bundle id of the XCTest test bundle.

args.description: Extra process arguments passed to the runner.

env.description: Extra environment variables passed to the runner.

WdaConfig.description: Configuration for launching a WebDriverAgent (XCUITest) runner session.

config.description: The configuration the session was started with.

udid.description: The device udid the session runs on.

page.description:
Inspectable page key. When empty the first matching web/javascript page
(optionally scoped by `bundleId`) is used.

bundleId.description: Optional bundle id to scope page selection.

page.description: The page key the script ran in.

result.description: The evaluation result (JSON value; shape depends on the script).

url.description: URL to open. May alternatively be supplied as the `url` query param.

bundleId.description: Bundle id to open the URL in. Defaults to Safari.
Bundle id the page was opened in.

url.description: The resolved current URL after navigation.

WebInspectorPage.description:
One inspectable page (`webinspector.ApplicationPage`) from
`GET /device/{udid}/webinspector/pages`. Open map — carries the application
and page descriptors as the device reports them.
